title: Moderna mRNA design and the AWS digital platform
titleEn: Moderna mRNA design and the AWS digital platform
fidelityNote: Two AWS pages state the early COVID-19 timeline differently. The 5 August 2020 AWS press release says the first clinical batch of mRNA-1273 reached NIH 42 days after the virus was sequenced. A later AWS case-study page says the sequence was completed in 2 days with machine learning on AWS and the first clinical batch was released 25 days later. Both sentences are stored. They are not merged into one number.
executiveSummary: Moderna runs its Drug Design Studio and manufacturing data path on AWS. Public AWS accounts describe a digital loop from sequence design, through machine learning, to an automated preclinical plant. The COVID-19 timeline is published in two forms, 42 days and 25 days, and this record keeps both with their sources. A PM using the story plans a design-to-batch path, a human quality review, and a citation rule so the two timelines are never collapsed.
problemStatement: mRNA constructs used to take years to reach even preclinical work. Sequence choice, compute, lab execution, and quality review sat in different systems. Cryo-EM and other instruments add tens of terabytes a day. A single heroic timeline in a slide hides which source said 25 days and which said 42.
opportunity: AWS describes Drug Design Studio on AWS: scientists pick proteins, algorithms propose mRNA sequences, jobs run through a queue and EC2, and an automated plant can make up to 1,000 constructs a month. The 5 August 2020 AWS release says Moderna selected AWS as its preferred cloud and standard for analytics and machine learning, and that the first clinical batch of mRNA-1273 went to NIH for Phase 1 42 days after sequencing. The case-study page states the 2-day sequence and 25-day batch. A 2017 AWS case quotes Marcello Damiani that a Zika vaccine candidate reached clinical trials in a year, against years in a traditional path.
strategicAlignment: The platform is the asset. A pandemic timeline is a published example with a source note, not a service level for the next program.
businessValue: Scientists can order a construct and reach preclinical experiments in weeks rather than years, which is how Damiani described the 2017 studio. The organization can show a regulator or partner which source supports which day count.
regulatoryContext: GLP where nonclinical work requires it
deploymentModelLabel: AWS for design, data, and manufacturing analytics
architecturePattern: Drug Design Studio proposes sequences, batch jobs move through a queue to compute, results return to the studio, and an automated plant makes the physical mRNA. Instrument data is centralized before a scientist trusts it. Quality review stays with a person.
planningBandNote: Amounts and durations below are planning bands for a similar program. They are not the publisher's result and not a price quote.
securityCapabilities: Human release of a clinical batch

narrative.heading: The published platform and the two timelines
narrative.body:
Moderna's Drug Design Studio, described in the 2017 AWS case, lets scientists select proteins and compute mRNA sequences. Jobs are stored, queued, processed, and returned to the studio. The preclinical plant was described as able to create as many as 1,000 constructs a month. Marcello Damiani said a Zika candidate reached clinical trials in a year, and that scientists could go from an idea to a preclinical experiment in less than a month, against years in a traditional path.

On 5 August 2020 AWS said Moderna had selected AWS as its preferred cloud and its standard for analytics and machine learning, and that the first clinical batch of mRNA-1273 was delivered to NIH for Phase 1 42 days after the virus was sequenced. An AWS case-study page says the sequence was completed in 2 days using machine learning on AWS and the first clinical batch was released 25 days later. Both statements stay in this record with their sources.

The same case-study page says cryo-EM can generate tens of terabytes a day and that Moderna used a data cloud on AWS to land, check, and harmonize instrument data. That is the integration requirement in this charter. It is not a license to quote a single pandemic interval as the next program's goal.

narrative.heading: The PM rule
narrative.body: One target. One ticket. One batch. One human release. Any day count in a slide has a URL, and 25 and 42 are never averaged.
